translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Mbi hanuni hayagola agali Holoberenesenaga biabe bia haga biaru ti abale heyalu piai hene. Ani biyagola Bagoasahanda Holoberenesenaga balai anda heagonaga panga payanda howa agali biabe biaga maru hearu ibunaga agali haguane padagoha anda napole lalu bi lamiai hene. Tomo nalu luore biru wahayagome agali bibahende de umu lai hene.
Yudidi ibu hangu Holoberenesela balai anda biagoha biraabo hene. Ani bereagola ai Holoberenese ibu lulu timbuni yalu mo ko hayagola ibuni tamu dagia wiagoria ibira halu palene.

Yudidihanda wali ibunaga biabe bia haga biago balai anda tagirahayagi haneni abale biagadagua ibu tagira ibuliya hondo habe lene. Wali ibunaga biabe bia haga biago lamialu ibu, Anduane Homogohondo bi lone lole porogo, lene. Ani bialu Bagoasahondobi ani dege lamini.

Agali mini lene birayarubi agali bame biabe bia haga birayarubi bibahende tomo nai halu pugu pugu biai hene. Ani piai hayagola Yudidi ibu Holoberenesenaga dagia kawareni heyu howa ibugua Anduane Homogohondo ibuni bu miniha bi ogodagua lene. Ngode Datagaliwabe í̠ore Anduane Homogo Hongo Haiheore kegoni. Horo áyu ogoningiore i̱na Yarusaleme mini yaraga halu biabe buleberogo buliya i̱naga gi mo hongo habe.

Í̠naga wali agali bayale helo biamogo bulenebi ina bope halu bo hengedolenaga waitigi áyu íbu karu bo haealabaga bialu mo habo lai holenaga biabe bule manda bu birarugobi bulene horo áyu ngagoni, lene.
Ani lalu Yudidi ibugua Holoberenesenaga haguandahayagi ayu tibu ale ogoni mo pehowa
yalu dagiani kaware hapara hene. Ibugua Holoberenesenaga mandarini yania ho howa lalu, Isaraele wali agalinaga Ngode Datagaliwabe í̠ni kego i̱ áyu ogoni mo hongo habe, lene.
Ani lowa Yudidi ibunaga hongo bibahendeoreme Holoberenesenaga mani halu kira dibalu haguane pugu ba̱i̱ hene.

Ani bialu ibunaga tingini dindini pendegelope halu dagiani hina bibime hayulino dambi haga labolabo baya tara heago hadowa gini yu hene. Emene howa Holoberenesenaga haguane biago yalu tagira puwa wali ibunaga biabe bia haga biagohondo mini.

Miyagola wali biago ibugua agali haguane biago tomo hanagane nuha henene. Yudidi ibu Bedulia dai binigo ogo Ai Yudidila wali ibunaga biabe biaga biagola Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lole piaga wiyadagua pene tingi halu puwa ai balai anda bu hearu yu wahai halu dindi tigabi wiagobi wahai halu pialu hari bare wiagoha irigi halu puwa Bedulia tanonaga wai pabe panga heagoria kaware anda pene.

Libu wene kaundiani dege wene pialu howa Yudidihanda agali maru wai pabe panga handaya ho howa mamage haga hearu olowa lalu, Panga duguadaba panga duguadaba. Inanaga Ngode Datagaliwabe ibuni inane heba mandagi haabo kago. Áyu dege inahondo ibunaga hongo ngago ina Isaraelehondo lone mo walia halu ibunaga hongome waitigi hearu bope haya, lene.
Agali tanoha hearume bi layuago Yudidihanda layuane hale halu ti abale gerai wai pabe heagoria puwa tanonaga agali haguane hearu ibilo olene.

Wali agali daliahebi wahealebi wandari igiribi bibahende Yudidi dai bulubada manda nabi howa gerai lalu wai pabe panga heagoria piai hene. Pialu tigua panga duguayagola anda pene. Anda piyagola wali agali tigua hale hedo yuwa ho mabu bini.

Ani heagola Yudidi ibugua bi hongo howa ladaga halu lalu, Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mini yaraga holene nga. Ibunaga mini daligaore kago yaraga holene nga. Ngode Datagaliwabehanda ina Isaraele wali agali dara haga kagonaga ina ibunaga mini yaraga holene nga. Áyu mbiraga dege Ngode Datagaliwabehanda inanaga waitigi i̱naga giha howa bo haeala hole biai haya, lalu latagi hene.

Ani lalu agali haguane nuha pugu hanayago ti de hendelo yaraga halu lalu, De handadaba. Agali haguane o yidogoni Holoberenese Asiria ami agali haguane biagonaga haguane o pugu yidogoni. Ani bialu aga ogo Holoberenese iba nowa luluyu wiagola ibu dambi hene. Anduane Homogohanda agali haguane ogoni wali mbiranaga giha howa bo wahaya.

I̱na heneneore gi dolalu howa larogo i̱na mbirale uruni buliya Anduane Homogo ibunime i̱ baya hangu handaya ho haya. I̱naga dengui baya tara handalu Holoberenese mo luluya henego homaya. Anigo ibugua i̱la mana ko nabi bayale halu i̱ mo ko halu mo tagabi nahe, lene.

Wali agali tigua mogo timbuni lalu tigua bulupaluwa Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lene. Ti bibahendeme bi lo mbira halu hongo howa ladagadaga bialu Ngode Datagaliwabenaga mini yaraga halu lalu, Iname Anduane Homogo inanaga Ngode Datagaliwabe í̠naga mini yaraga harama. Áyu í̠naga wali agali kemarunaga waitigi hearu mo taga harida, lene.

Ai Usiahanda Yudidihondo lalu, I̱ wane Yudidi-o Ngode Datagaliwabehanda dindi bibahendeha wali biru ngaru berelowa í̠naga mini timbuni mini lene berelayada. Anduane Homogo inanaga Ngode Datagaliwabe ibugua dindi harila wabini kagonaga mini yaraga hama. Ibunime í̠na bibelo mo bia hayagola í̠na inanaga waitigi hearunaga agali haguane heagonaga haguane puguarida.
Horo bibahendengi mani wali agaliru Ngode Datagaliwabenaga hongo ngago te lalu howa tigua í̠naga mini mbiraore hongohe wiridago te lalu holebira.

Í̠na mbirale uruni biridagonaga Ngode Datagaliwabehanda í̠hondo bayale biaabo helo laro. Wali agali mo ko holene kawareni hemagola í̠na ibunaga deni tigatiga ibagabu biruwa í̠ni homolene mo embeda halu birigonaga ibugua í̠hondo mbirale bayale damene ngaru ngiai helo laro, lene. Ani layagola wali agali bibahendeme bi lo mbira halu lalu, Henene heneneore, lai hene.
